basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 8-9.' and it opens 'Vers. 8, 9. Judas quoque dixit: Mitte puerum mecum, usque, reus ero peccati in patrem'. The printing's caput is stale here, its marker for this chapter being missing, so the chapter is taken from the lemma, whose best match anywhere in Genesis falls on the very verse the printing numbers.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 8, 9. Judas quoque dixit: Mitte puerum mecum, usque, reus ero peccati in patrem meum omni tempore. Consideremus verba Ruben, quae superius posita sunt. Ait enim: Duos filios meos interfice, si non reduxero eum tibi. Et tamen cum tam magnam rem, mortem videlicet filiorum, proposuerit, | non obtinuit quod volebat. Consideremus et verba Judae, quibus se pro puero obligavit: Si non reduxero, inquit, eum tibi, reus ero peccati omni tempore, et impetravit quod volebat. Ejus enim curae Benjamin commissus est. Videamus ergo ne plus sit reum esse peccati quam corporaliter aliquem occidi.
